propositions: The review_bot currently computes per-call token usage (_extract_usage: input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_tokens, cache_write_tokens) and attaches it as result["_usage"], but discards these fields instead of emitting them to CloudWatch.

finalize.py must aggregate token fields across all succeeded steps carrying _usage and add input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_tokens, cache_write_tokens, and total_tokens to coverage["metrics"], tolerating steps without _usage (contributing 0).

voter.py must expose _publish_token_usage_metrics() as a best-effort boto3 put_metric_data call emitting five review_bot_llm_*_tokens metrics to Namespace="rebar/host" with Unit="Count", swallowing import/credential/network errors.

review_and_vote must call _publish_token_usage_metrics after a successful vote, reading totals from decision["verdict"]["coverage"]["metrics"], with a greppable LLM_TOKEN_USAGE JSON marker to stderr/journald as a reliable fallback.

Pass-1 finder-batch _usage is out of scope for this ticket and deferred to a linked follow-up, as it requires threading through the shared plan_review path; only Pass-2 verify and Pass-3 decide agent-step usage is covered here.
Token counts (not dollar costs) are emitted; metric emission never fails the review (best-effort, fail-open contract identical to existing error publishers).
